facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 必须明确是 Hard Tech product；技术原则至少已想清楚。SOSV FAQ 表示最终进入项目通常需要至少2名 cofounders。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 机器人/工业/气候/healthcare/consumer hardtech；强工程团队、原型、验证过的问题、能快速迭代物理产品。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: HAX 为 in-person 硬科技项目；当前申请地点包括 Newark, NJ 与 Princeton Plasma Forge。历史/部分项目也涉及深圳。
facts_raw.International Founder: Yes — anyone from anywhere can apply
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: SOSV 表示接受国际团队，入选后可协助 legal/immigration；为融资通常建议美国公司结构。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 公司/地点、140字描述、founder 信息、LinkedIn 等；确认正在做 Hard Tech。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方 HAX apply form；面试中确认地点/移民安排。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 硬件 / 机器人 / DeepTech；阶段以 Pre-seed–seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目

facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: A hard-tech product with a clear technical principle. SOSV's FAQ states that final admission generally requires at least two cofounders.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Robotics, industrial, climate, healthcare and consumer hard-tech teams with strong engineering, prototypes, validated problems and rapid physical-product iteration.
facts.On-site / Attendance: HAX is an in-person hard-tech program. Current locations include Newark, NJ and Princeton Plasma Forge; historical and some other programs involve Shenzhen.
facts.International Founder: Yes — anyone from anywhere can apply
facts.Visa / Relocation: SOSV accepts international teams and can assist with legal and immigration matters after selection. A US company structure is generally recommended for fundraising.
facts.Application Materials: Company, location, a 140-character description, founder details and LinkedIn profiles; confirm a hard-tech focus.
facts.Public Contact Route: Official HAX application; confirm location and immigration arrangements during interviews.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Hardware / Robotics / DeepTech; primarily at the Pre-seed–seed stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration; Projects without core technology or IP, including undifferentiated apps and trading businesses
